titulo: Quiz — the bag, the bill and the door left open
subtitulo: Check-out at eleven, flight at nine, and the afternoon you got back
introPt: A traveller hands back the key, keeps the day, settles the bill and leaves the sentence that gets them asked back.
cenario: Reception on the last morning, bags packed, flight in the evening.

dialogo.es: Καλημέρα, φεύγω σήμερα. Μπορώ να αφήσω τις βαλίτσες μέχρι το βράδυ;
dialogo.pt: Good morning, I'm leaving today. Can I leave my bags until this evening?
dialogo.tts: Καλημέρα, φεύγω σήμερα. Μπορώ να αφήσω τις βαλίτσες μέχρι το βράδυ;

dialogo.es: Φυσικά. Θα τις βάλω στον χώρο αποσκευών.
dialogo.pt: Of course. I'll put them in the luggage room.
dialogo.tts: Φυσικά. Θα τις βάλω στον χώρο αποσκευών.

dialogo.pt: Thank you. How much is it all together?

dialogo.es: Τετρακόσια δέκα. Ορίστε η απόδειξη. Καλό ταξίδι!
dialogo.pt: Four hundred and ten. Here's your receipt. Safe journey!
dialogo.tts: Τετρακόσια δέκα. Ορίστε η απόδειξη. Καλό ταξίδι!

perguntas.pergunta: When is the best moment to ask them to keep your bags?
opcoes: While the key is still in your hand
After you have handed the key back
When you come back for them
perguntas.explica: Asked during check-out it is part of check-out. Asked afterwards it is a favour from someone with no room.

perguntas.pergunta: The bags are in the luggage room. What is the second question?
opcoes: Μέχρι τι ώρα — until what time
perguntas.explica: A luggage room is only useful while somebody is there to open it. Get the hour before you walk off.

perguntas.pergunta: From central Athens, what does the metro to the airport cost one way?
perguntas.explica: €9.00 one way, €16.00 return. The Express bus is €5.50, and the ordinary €1.20 ticket does not cover the airport line.

perguntas.pergunta: Your plans change and your ferry ticket goes unused. Can you give it to someone else?
opcoes: Yes, a ticket is a ticket
No — the ticket carries your name by law
perguntas.explica: Greek ferry tickets are nominal: name, sex, nationality and date of birth are registered. Changes go through the company.

perguntas.pergunta: Which line closes the week the way it is closed here?
perguntas.explica: Θα ξανάρθω — I'll come back. Nobody hears it as a contract, and the answer is usually να 'στε καλά or καλό ταξίδι.
